uses.label: Syro-Malabar Catholic Church
uses.finding: Complete scans now cover the 1962, 1968 and 1986 operative books and the 2021, 2018 and 2025 official component books; consultation drafts of 1967, 1984 and 1985 and experimental 1971 forms are identified. Early printed books (1774, 1775, 1844/1845) and the 1959/1960 originals remain unacquired.
uses.limit: No collation of any state; early Roman printings and most 1989-2013 books not acquired; Malayalam composition-versus-translation review still open.
next_sources: Pallath, Restoration and Reform of Syro-Malabar Missal (2018)
Roman Documents on the Syro-Malabar Liturgy (GPURA item 5087)
CMS India RR-042, RR-105, RR-122 holdings
Commission for Liturgy for the 2018 Syriac typica and 2025 Christmas text
uses.review_remaining_gap: Corrections: native-title and book_label consistency for 1962, 1968, 1985-86, 2021 and the 1984 draft; origin-review research_priority on the 15 Malayalam records placed in origin review; Podipara authorship not proven; formation paper is signed and dated; version malabar-v-1974-mini-mass falsely merges the Mini Mass with the Ernakulam Bharatheeya Pooja (GPURA 27232); malabar-v-1969-dharmaram wrongly offers GPURA 14581 (an English 'Divine Liturgy' of 1969) as a Dharmaram form; malabar-v-1868-poojakarmmangal is the Tukasa ceremonial and its 1926 revision is omitted; GPURA 14149 (1941) is a Malayalam people's translation (deferred) per its abstract; the version date_label for 1962 attaches the 20 January 1962 instruction to the bilingual book although it promulgated the Syriac missal. No collation of any state; 1774, 1775, 1844, 1959, 1960 Taksa, 1989, 2005, 2011, 2013, 2018 Syriac and 2025 Christmas books unacquired.
